title: Which Florida Beach Towns Are Closest to a Major Airport?
dek: Fort Lauderdale and Hollywood are about 15 minutes from FLL, and Sarasota is 15 from SRQ. Naples gets airline service again on Dec. 2.
body:
Fort Lauderdale and Hollywood are the Florida beach towns closest to a major airport, about 10 to 15 minutes from Fort Lauderdale International, and Miami's South Beach and Key Biscayne are 20 to 25 minutes from Miami International. On the Gulf side, downtown Sarasota is about 15 minutes from the Sarasota Bradenton airport, and Bonita Springs and Dunedin are each about 25 minutes from theirs.

Every town we cover gets an airport access score from 1 to 5, based on the drive time to the nearest major airport. The drive times below come from our town pages; summer beach traffic and winter bridge backups can add a lot to them.

Typical home prices are from our town pages and are recent sale medians, mostly from early 2026. South Florida wins on distance, but the beaches there are busier and the towns denser. Sarasota is the rare Gulf town with an airport this close, though it has no beach downtown; Lido Beach is about ten minutes over the bridge. In the Panhandle, Fort Walton Beach is the closest to an airport but scores lower for beaches than Destin, half an hour away.

Which Florida airports have the most flights?

A short drive to a small airport is not the same as a short drive to a big one. The Federal Aviation Administration's final count for 2025 shows how lopsided Florida's airports are. These numbers are boardings, which run about half of total passengers.

Orlando International, the busiest airport in the state, handled about 57.7 million passengers in 2025. Tampa handled about 24.8 million passengers in 2025 and Southwest Florida International set a record with about 11.2 million.

The smaller airports are growing fast. Sarasota Bradenton set a record with about 4.5 million passengers in 2025, and Daytona Beach had about 772,000, its most since 1997, after JetBlue added daily nonstops to New York and Boston in December 2025. Destin Fort Walton Beach also added JetBlue flights to Boston and New York this year. Smaller airports usually mean fewer nonstops, more connections and more seasonal routes, so check the winter and summer schedules before you count on one.

What changes in Naples on December 2?

On Dec. 2, American Airlines starts two daily flights between Naples Airport and Charlotte on 65 seat regional jets, according to the Business Observer, with connections to about 180 destinations through Charlotte. It is the first airline service at Naples Airport since Elite Airways left in 2017 and American's first there since 2001. Until now, most people in Naples have driven about 40 minutes north to Southwest Florida International in Fort Myers, and people on Marco Island about 50 minutes to an hour. Fort Myers will still have far more flights, but for trips to the Northeast and the Midwest, a connection through Charlotte from a gate in town may beat the drive.

Which beach towns are farthest from an airport?

The quietest stretches of the coast are quiet partly because they are hard to get to. From St. George Island, Tallahassee's airport is about an hour and 40 minutes away, and Northwest Florida Beaches is a little over two hours. Port St. Joe is about an hour from Northwest Florida Beaches, and Crescent Beach, south of St. Augustine, is about an hour from Daytona Beach and about an hour and 10 minutes from Jacksonville. If you will fly often, for work or to see grandchildren, add those drives to every trip before you fall for one of these towns.

How much should airport access matter?

For most people who move here, it matters more than they expect. Visiting family is easier when the drive from the airport is short, and remote workers who travel for meetings tend to feel the difference every month. Our guide to the best beach towns for remote work weighs airports along with internet and coworking, and our guide to picking your coast explains how the Gulf, the Atlantic and the Panhandle differ in everything else.
faq: Which Florida beach town is closest to a major airport?
Fort Lauderdale and Hollywood, both about 10 to 15 minutes from Fort Lauderdale International (FLL). South Beach and Key Biscayne are about 20 to 25 minutes from Miami International.
Which Gulf Coast beach town is closest to an airport?

Downtown Sarasota is about 15 minutes from Sarasota Bradenton International (SRQ), with Lido Beach about ten minutes farther over the bridge. Bonita Springs and Dunedin are each about 25 minutes from an airport.

Starting Dec. 2, 2026, American Airlines flies twice a day between Naples Airport and Charlotte, the first airline service there since 2017. Most flights still go through Southwest Florida International in Fort Myers, about 40 minutes north.

St. George Island is about an hour and 40 minutes from Tallahassee's airport, Port St. Joe is about an hour from Northwest Florida Beaches, and Crescent Beach is about an hour from Daytona Beach.
